usage: The phrase '我個女' is used to refer to one's own daughter.
It is a possessive noun phrase combining the pronoun '我' (I/my) and '個女' (daughter) with a classifier '個'.
You can use '我個女' as the subject or object in a sentence.
It is common to use '我個女' in casual conversations when talking about your child.
It can be followed by verbs or descriptive words to give more details, for example, '我個女好叻' means 'my daughter is very smart'.
